The existing Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Night Note fields are kept for compatibility. They remain synchronized with the first note of each mode. The scene, animation and Gallery are unchanged.

Preview only · Dashboard unchanged

Time Sync & Cinematic Motion · 07D

Automatic time selects the live scene. Manual preview uses a matching demonstration clock.

Studio preview only

Animations are photographic overlays, not actual moving-camera video. Operating-system reduced-motion preference is respected. Save Banner to retain these settings.

Live Weather · Step 07G

Real-time conditions in the right-hand banner panel. Weather data requires internet.

Select a city, then Refresh Weather. Your settings save automatically.

Weather data by Open-Meteo. Auto-location needs browser permission and HTTPS; local weather cannot be fetched offline.
